headline: Brazilian Federal Police Indict Banco Master Figures in Financial Crimes Inquiry
summary: Brazil's Federal Police concluded an inquiry into Banco Master, indicting banker Daniel Vorcaro and former Banco de Brasília president Paulo Henrique Costa for financial crimes related to a R$17.5 billion credit portfolio transaction.
why: Banco de Brasília is a state-controlled financial institution, and investigations into massive credit portfolio irregularities involve significant banking sector governance issues.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Regulatory and police investigations into financial irregularities increase scrutiny on credit transactions between private and public banks.
